title: Cloud Shared Responsibility Control Matrix
description: Provider-neutral cloud shared responsibility controls with atomic objectives, outcomes, tests, owner assignments, operational security lifecycles and standards cross-references.
atomicity_rule: One control objective, one expected outcome, one test and one owner assignment per control record.
contractual_reference_status: Provider-neutral placeholders must be replaced with exact clauses for the selected provider and service.

field_definitions.service_model: Cloud service model or scope to which the control applies.
field_definitions.control_objective: Single control objective for the record.
field_definitions.expected_outcome: Single observable result expected when the control operates effectively.
field_definitions.test: Single test procedure used to assess the expected outcome.
field_definitions.shared_control_component: Control activity components represented by the workbook's Control activity type column.
field_definitions.ism_applicability: ISM applicability profile codes recorded for the control; confirm against the selected system classification/profile.
field_definitions.ism_mapping_strength: Direct means a numbered ISM control is mapped; Contextual means the mapping is to an ISM principle/theme; Supporting identifies a secondary relationship.
field_definitions.rasci: Actor-oriented RASCI assignment for the cloud service provider, cloud service customer and third party.
field_definitions.references: Thematic standards mappings and provider contractual reference placeholder.

rasci_codes.R: Responsible: performs the control activity or testable work.
rasci_codes.A: Accountable: owns successful completion and accepts the result.
rasci_codes.S: Support: provides active assistance, platform capability or operational help.
rasci_codes.C: Consulted: provides input before a decision or action is completed.
rasci_codes.I: Informed: receives relevant status, outcomes or notifications.
rasci_codes.R/A: The same party is both responsible and accountable.

owner_assignments.CSP: Cloud service provider operates the control.
owner_assignments.CSC: Cloud service customer operates the control.
owner_assignments.SH-S: Provider and customer operate separate implementations at their respective layers.
owner_assignments.SH-D: Effective operation depends on coordinated provider and customer activities.
owner_assignments.INH: Customer inherits a provider-operated control and validates applicable assurance.
owner_assignments.3PTY: A named MSP, ISV, identity provider, carrier or subprocessor operates the control.
owner_assignments.GAP: No party has accepted or implemented the control.
owner_assignments.N/A: The control is demonstrably outside the assessed scope.

controls.control_objective: Maintain a cloud security governance framework
controls.expected_outcome: Cloud security decisions, roles and escalation paths are formally governed.
controls.test: Inspect the approved framework and verify its annual review record.

controls.expected_outcome: One accountable customer owner is assigned to each cloud system.
controls.test: Sample each in-scope system and verify a current named owner and acceptance record.

controls.expected_outcome: All sanctioned cloud services, tenants, owners and classifications are recorded.
controls.test: Reconcile the register against billing, identity and discovery inventories.

controls.expected_outcome: Provider security, resilience, privacy and supply-chain risks are assessed before approval.
controls.test: Inspect the completed assessment and verify unresolved findings have approved treatment.

controls.expected_outcome: Legal, regulatory, policy and contractual requirements are mapped to cloud controls.
controls.test: Trace a sample of obligations to implemented controls and accountable owners.

controls.expected_outcome: Provider, customer and third-party control activities are unambiguously assigned.
controls.test: Review the signed responsibility matrix for gaps, overlaps and unassigned controls.

controls.expected_outcome: Cloud risks and control effectiveness are reviewed after material change and periodically.
controls.test: Inspect review minutes and verify overdue treatments are escalated.

controls.expected_outcome: Only authorised delegates accept residual cloud security risk.
controls.test: Sample accepted risks and verify authority, rationale, expiry and review date.

controls.expected_outcome: The provider supplies current independent assurance for the contracted service scope.
controls.test: Verify report currency, auditor independence, service coverage and qualifications.

controls.expected_outcome: The customer confirms that services, regions and control periods used are covered.
controls.test: Compare deployed services and regions with the assurance report scope.

controls.expected_outcome: Provider audit exceptions receive documented customer impact and treatment decisions.
controls.test: Sample exceptions and verify assessment, owner, due date and closure evidence.

controls.expected_outcome: The customer can obtain sufficient evidence or conduct agreed assurance activities.
controls.test: Confirm the contract grants usable evidence access and test one evidence request.

controls.expected_outcome: Only authorised provider personnel can enter protected data-centre areas.
controls.test: Review independent assurance evidence for physical access approval and monitoring.

controls.expected_outcome: Provider personnel with privileged access are screened to contracted requirements.

controls.test: Sample new accounts and verify approval preceded provisioning.

controls.expected_outcome: Customer access is removed within the required period after termination or role change.
controls.test: Compare HR events with revocation timestamps for a sample of users.

controls.expected_outcome: Customer access rights are periodically recertified by accountable owners.
controls.test: Inspect the latest review and verify exceptions were removed or approved.

controls.expected_outcome: Customer permissions are limited to the minimum needed for approved duties.
